item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing a Khamenei-authored or Khamenei-announced budget line, implementation timeline, agency scorecard, or formal enforcement chain for the economic program. The evidence is therefore mostly indirect: speeches, elite vetting, cabinet approval, security enforcement, and proxy/network mobilization, rather than a full operational plan on paper.","evidence":[{"title":"Khamenei and Raisi Speeches on Nowruz","publisher":"The Iran Primer / USIP","date":"2024-03-21","url":"https://iranprimer.usip.org/index.php/blog/2024/mar/21/khamenei-and-raisi-speeches-nowruz","summary":"Khamenei set an explicit 2024 economic program around domestic production, inflation control, jobs, and currency stabilization, and said foreign agreements should become “national executive contracts” with tangible results. That shows the ruling network was still being used to channel cabinet formation, but the result looks compromise-driven rather than like a sharply engineered program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","7B.5","7B.9"]},{"title":"Iran’s Khamenei urges allies to step up struggle against Israel","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"2024-10-05","url":"https://theprint.in/world/irans-khamenei-urges-allies-to-step-up-struggle-against-israel/2298142/","summary":"Khamenei publicly called on regional allies to “double your efforts and capabilities” and intensify resistance against Israel. This is direct mobilization of the regional proxy/military network toward his strategic goal of confrontation with Israel.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.1","8B.2"]},{"title":"Iran’s Revolutionary Guards extend control over Tehran’s oil exports, sources say","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/irans-revolutionary-guards-extend-control-over-tehrans-oil-exports-sources-say-3778558","summary":"Reuters reported the IRGC had tightened its grip on oil exports and controlled up to half of them, using shadow fleets and front companies, with oil revenue flowing to state spending and proxies. This is strong evidence that Khamenei’s system mobilized a core revenue stream through security networks rather than neutral bureaucracy.","question_ids":["8B.3","7B.9","8B.2"]},{"title":"Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-12-10","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/","summary":"Amnesty says the judiciary drafted the law, the Guardian Council approved it, parliament announced it would take effect, and enforcement powers were expanded for police, intelligence, IRGC, and Basij. This is a clear example of the state apparatus being mobilized to enforce an ideological project.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2"]},{"title":"IAEA board passes resolution against Iran on cooperation, inspectors","publisher":"Reuters / Investing.com","date":"2024-06-05","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/iaea-board-passes-resolution-against-iran-on-cooperation-inspectors-3472087","summary":"Reuters reported Iran had barred many experienced inspectors and the IAEA Board demanded reversal. This is evidence against a serious implementation pipeline for the economic program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Iran will not impede IAEA access, head of its atomic organisation says","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"2024-12-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/iran-will-not-impede-iaea-access-head-of-its-atomic-organisation-says/2403254/","summary":"Iran said it would not obstruct UN watchdog access and would work within safeguards. This is the clearest late-year procedural positive signal, but it is narrow and late rather than evidence of a broad, durable implementation system.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.2","7B.6"]}]}
